reader_summary.overview: Howard Marks in conversation about market cycles, investor psychology, and where the current market sits on the swing from optimism to fear. He works through three of his memos, explaining why cognitive dissonance lets markets ignore bad news until a critical mass of it arrives. He also revisits the growth versus value divide he now thinks is a false one, argues that selling should be treated as a decision to un-buy.
